title: Jarring Indian Bulgur Thali
description: A charred, shattering gluten‑free meal prep thali featuring bulgur wheat, binchotan‑charred veggies, chickpeas, and a spiced coconut milk sauce.

ingredients.name: Indian spice mix
ingredients.amount: 3 tsp (turmeric 1 tsp, garam masala 1 tsp, cumin 1 tsp)

instructions: Rinse bulgur wheat until water runs clear.
In a saucepan, bring water to a boil, add bulgur, reduce heat, cover, simmer 15 minutes, then remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes.
While bulgur cooks, heat a dry skillet over an open flame with binchotan charcoal until glowing, then add onion, bell pepper, carrot, and oil, char until blackened, about 5 minutes.
Transfer charred veggies to a bowl, squeeze lemon juice over them, and set aside.
In a small saucepan, heat coconut milk with Indian spice mix and salt until simmering, about 3 minutes.
In a separate pot, warm chickpeas until hot, about 2 minutes.
Fluff cooked bulgur with a fork and divide into 4 bowls.
Top each bowl with a layer of charred vegetable mix and a spoonful of warm chickpeas.
Drizzle the spiced coconut milk sauce over the bowls.
Garnish each thali with a sprinkle of fresh coriander.
Serve immediately, or cover and refrigerate for up to 4 days for meal prep.
